_what: Species and build checks on the rendered release-116 VEP web form, for the 2026-09-28 catalogue fixes (species_frequency, cadd, intact, var_synonyms, geno2mp, and the three human custom files).

_pages.grch38_multi: https://jun2026.archive.ensembl.org/Multi/Tools/VEP (title 'Variant Effect Predictor - Homo_sapiens - Ensembl genome browser 116'; www.ensembl.org redirected here; REST /info/software = 116)

_method: javascript in the loaded page: input names; the _stt_<Species> classes on the nearest ancestor that carries any; label[for] text; defaultChecked.

custom_files_rendered._note: No page renders a non-human custom file: 0 matches for PRJEB or nextgen in the HTML of any of the four. release_116/vep_custom_web_config.json lists 8 non-human entries (chicken, dog, dog boxer, goat, sheep x2, sheep texel x2); release_116/InputForm.pm:1205-1209 keeps an entry only if the page's ASSEMBLY_NAME starts with the entry's assembly, and the VEP page answers with the human build from every species' URL.

custom_homo_sapiens_AllOfUs.label: AllOfUs allele frequencies
custom_homo_sapiens_AllOfUs.control: checkbox in 'Frequency data for co-located variants'

plugin_species_classes_grch38._species_values: The form's species value for the Red Jungle fowl is 'Gallus_gallus_GCA_000002315.5'; the broiler reference is 'Gallus_gallus'. IntAct's class spells the genome 'gca000002315v5', which does not equal that value.
plugin_species_classes_grch38._every_other_plugin: Every other plugin checkbox on the page carries the same species as vep_options.json (compared by species on 2026-09-28).

geno2mp._note: no assembly class; the form offers it on both builds
